methodology: Swept the champion model's (LightGBM) calibrated PD on validation (2014) over its empirical distribution. For each candidate PD cut-off, approved = PD <= cut-off. Picked the cut-off that maximizes TOTAL expected net value (sum of (1-PD)*interest_income - PD*loan_amnt*LGD across approved loans) on validation. This fixed PD value is then applied unchanged to all three models on test - each model approves test loans with its OWN calibrated PD <= this value.

lgd.formula: LGD_i = 1 - clip((total_pymnt_i + recoveries_i - collection_recovery_fee_i) / funded_amnt_i, 0, 1); LGD = mean(LGD_i) across train-year (2012-2013) charged-off, 36-month, individual loans

expected_net_value_formula: EV_i = (1 - PD_i) * interest_income_i - PD_i * loan_amnt_i * LGD
note: Chosen entirely from validation (2014) and train (2012-2013). Test (2015) has not been read anywhere in this script. This cutoff, LGD, and interest-income formula are now FIXED and will be applied identically to test with no further adjustment.
